notes.title: Quant is on sale
notes.notes:
Dear Quantum explorers,

I decided to make Quant available more easily to everyone, and thus reduced its cost.

It's time to leap into the adventure!

notes.title: Quant Beta Now Available!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

I hereby announce you the launch of the free Beta version of Quant!

You can play for free at the first two chapters of the full game, in close-to-release state!

After you have enjoyed it, please leave some feedback, or report bugs on the page of the game. It helps me improving the game, and providing a better experience for you all!

Also, if you haven't done so yet, please whishlist the game, it really helps me getting more visibility in the ocean of games...

Cheers,
PetRem Labs

notes.title: Updated Demo available!
notes.notes:
Hello folks!

I have been working a lot on Quant lately, and I improved the graphics (and mechanics) quite a bit.
So I thought I wasn't fair to leave the blunt looking old demo...

Thus, I spent some time to improve it too. The changes are major, so even if you already played it, I recommend you to dive a second time into this world. You will have a better idea of the final looking of the game.

Enjoy!
Remy from PetRem Labs

PS: I also uploaded a new trailer and screenshots of the full game, go check them out.
PPS: Also wishlist the full game if you haven't yet :)

notes.title: Quant release date
notes.notes:
Hi curious people!

I am sorry to announce that I will have to delay the release of Quant, due to many reasons, including you-know-what (a certain current social crisis).
But don't worry! This is for the best trust me. Instead of rushing and delivering an unfinished game, I will take my time to make the story as interesting, the gameplay as fun, and the physics as simple as possible. And I'm working now with a very talented and experienced music composer (FruitSaladSound), who will make your journey unforgettable.

I'm hoping to release Quant: Leap into the journey next year, around Christmas.

Stay tuned, and keep studying! :)

Remy,
PetRemLabs

notes.title: Quant Demo is out!
notes.notes:
The free demo of Quant is out now!
It is an adventure game that teaches you basic principles of Quantum Mechanics, and it should be fun!

The demo gives a very small glimpse at what the game should look like.

The full game's release is planned for the end of the year.
Add the game to your wishlist if you're interested!
